decision.question: What counts as an unacceptable quality/performance delta over a 1,000-session soak, and how is it measured?
decision.option_name: drift-within-run as the primary gate, plus deliberately loose absolute sanity floors
decision.numbers_provenance: PRE-REGISTERED AND UNMEASURED. Every threshold below was set by argument before any soak session ran, because a threshold derived from the run it judges cannot fail that run. None of them has a measurement behind it and none may be presented as an empirical limit.
decision.supersedes_clause: The first complete soak on all three families archives its observed distributions as the program's first per-platform baseline. A later phase is REQUIRED to re-derive these bands from that baseline for the NEXT candidate. Without this clause today's invented numbers become precedent. Re-deriving them for THIS candidate would be option D and is forbidden.
decision.widening_after_measurement: FORBIDDEN. A band widened after a result is a finding against the certifier, not a correction to the band.

workload.surface_source: evidence/28-01/candidate.json resolved surfaces, read at execution time
workload.interleave: round-robin over the workload surfaces so every block carries the same surface mix; without this the late window is a different workload from the early window and the drift measures the mix
workload.safety_filter: read-only leaf verbs only; a soak that runs self-update or plugin install a thousand times is a hazard, not a measurement

warmup.mode: one occurrence of every workload surface, executed before the 1,000 counted sessions and excluded from them
warmup.structural_signature: sorted top-level key set when the output parses as JSON; otherwise the line count and the absence of every forbidden sentinel
warmup.broken_inventory_rule: a surface whose warm-up fails the sanity schema establishes NO invariant and is recorded as broken inventory. Warm-up may bind a value; it may never define whatever happened as correct.

windows.aggregation: compute the statistic per 100-session block, then compare the MEDIAN OF THE EARLY BLOCK VALUES against the MEDIAN OF THE LATE BLOCK VALUES. A single load spike must move the median of three separate blocks to move the verdict.
windows.cold_start_handling: block 1 is INCLUDED in the early window. Discarding it would delete a real product property from the measurement; it is instead retained and the per-block series is published so a reader can see it.

sampling.sample_at: quiescent points between sessions, after all concurrent children of the preceding sessions have been joined

drift.rationale: a 50% degradation of the median across a thousand sessions is generous for a shared host and far short of what accumulated on-disk state produces once it is O(N).
the tail degrades first under resource pressure; p90 over a 100-session block has ten samples above it, which is enough to be an estimator rather than an outlier.
a rate near 1.0 has no room for a ratio band; two percentage points of late-run correctness loss is a definitive signal and is not reachable by host noise.

floors.rationale: this is the floor that answers the uniformly-broken run, which drift cannot see. It is the reason the decision is C and not A.
also the harness per-session timeout. One minute for a local CLI invocation is operationally defective on any of the three boxes.
deliberately catastrophic-only and identical on all three platforms. Fabricating per-platform ceilings with no per-platform baseline would be inventing three numbers instead of one.

slopes.rationale: the primary unbounded-growth path in a soak of fresh short-lived processes: nothing survives a process except what it wrote down.
sampled at quiescent points, so any growth at all is a product process that outlived the session that spawned it.
a child whose pipes are never closed leaks a handle per session; measured on the harness because that is the side that holds them.
recorded honestly as a property of the measuring process, not of the product; a doubling would mean the harness is the thing leaking and the run is suspect.

positive_controls.canary: one control canary is deliberately leaked into a scanned channel and MUST be detected; a clean scan with an undetected control is VOID
positive_controls.orphan: one control process is deliberately orphaned and MUST be found; a zero census with an unfound control is VOID
positive_controls.resource: one control lane grows deliberately and its slope MUST be flagged by the same evaluator; a flat verdict from an evaluator that cannot see growth is VOID
positive_controls.drift: the bands file itself is the drift control: with no bands file the drift verdict is VOID rather than defaulted

noise_rule.on_drift_breach: RED. The covariate series is evidence that may justify exactly one re-run on a quiet host; it may never convert a breach into a pass.
noise_rule.third_verdict_between_pass_and_fail: NOT PERMITTED. A load-adjusted INCONCLUSIVE is a dismissal lever with a statistician's vocabulary, and inventing a state to escape an unwanted result is a named prohibition on this program.
noise_rule.rerun_rule: a re-run must be green on its own numbers; a second breach is final.

naming_honesty.quality: This is a DETERMINISM-AND-STABILITY measurement, not a semantic quality measurement. It detects a surface that stops behaving as it behaved at warm-up. It does not detect a surface that behaves consistently and wrongly. The results document must say so in those words.
naming_honesty.drift_coverage: In a soak of 1,000 fresh short-lived processes a per-process leak cannot accumulate, so latency drift can only fire through state that survives a process — accumulated on-disk state, orphaned children, or host contention. The detection weight for unbounded resource use therefore sits on the SLOPE bands, not on the drift bands.
